<style>
/* Sprint Studio: a photographed creative-team table (camera, controller, tablet, flipbook, code, sticky notes, growth chart, phone). Live sprint data printed in cream on the teal mat; every team tool is a hotspot */
.tm {
  --cream: #f6eedd;
  --cream-2: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.78);
  --teal: #0f4f45;
  --coral: #f07a5f;
  --mustard: #e8b44a;
  --lilac: #b9a6e0;
  --ink: #2a2118;
  --sans: var(--font-anthropic-sans), -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 22px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #3a2716;
  color: var(--cream);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  color-scheme: dark;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -30px rgba(40, 22, 6, 0.8);
}
.tm-scene { position: relative; container-type: inline-size; aspect-ratio: 1672 / 941; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
.tm-photo { position: absolute; inset: -1.5%; background: url("/_blob/eb2811ef4ffbe6711395af12226c8393") center / cover no-repeat; transform: translate3d(var(--px, 0), var(--py, 0), 0) scale(1.01); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
.tm-light { position: absolute; inset: -20%; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: soft-light; opacity: 0.45; background: repeating-linear-gradient(125deg, rgba(255, 220, 160, 0) 0 7%, rgba(255, 220, 160, 0.6) 7% 9.5%, rgba(255, 220, 160, 0) 9.5% 15%); }
.tm-o { position: absolute; }
.tm-kicker { left: 23.6%; top: 22%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6cqw; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.9cqw; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream-2); }
.tm-kicker i { width: 0.55cqw; height: 0.55cqw; border-radius: 50%; background: #5fe0a6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.3cqw rgba(95, 224, 166, 0.22); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .tm-kicker i { animation: tm-beat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes tm-beat { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.7cqw rgba(95, 224, 166, 0.05); } } }
.tm-days { left: 60.2%; top: 21%; width: 11.4%; }
.tm-days svg { width: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.tm-frame { left: 47.5%; top: 26%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 0.8cqw 2.2cqw 0.9cqw; border: 1.5px solid rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.85); white-space: nowrap; }
.tm-frame b { position: absolute; width: 0.7cqw; height: 0.7cqw; background: var(--coral); border: 1.5px solid var(--cream); }
.tm-frame b:nth-of-type(1) { left: -0.42cqw; top: -0.42cqw; } .tm-frame b:nth-of-type(2) { right: -0.42cqw; top: -0.42cqw; }
.tm-frame b:nth-of-type(3) { left: -0.42cqw; bottom: -0.42cqw; } .tm-frame b:nth-of-type(4) { right: -0.42cqw; bottom: -0.42cqw; }
.tm-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 4.8cqw; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: transparent; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fffaf0 25%, #f3d8b8 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; }
.tm-dates { left: 47.5%; top: 39.6%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.9cqw; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream-2); white-space: nowrap; }
.tm-switch { left: 47.5%; top: 43.2%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8cqw; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.82cqw; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream-2); }
.tm-toggle { appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 4.6cqw; height: 2.3cqw; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9a7e, var(--coral)); box-shadow: inset 0 0.15cqw 0.3cqw rgba(255,255,255,0.35), inset 0 -0.2cqw 0.4cqw rgba(90,20,0,0.35), 0 0.4cqw 0.8cqw -0.2cqw rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }
.tm-toggle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0.22cqw; left: 0.22cqw; width: 1.86cqw; height: 1.86cqw; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fff, #ece4d6); box-shadow: 0 0.2cqw 0.4cqw rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transform: translateX(var(--knob, 2.3cqw)); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1); }
.tm-toggle[aria-checked="false"] { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8fa9a3, #5f7c76); --knob: 0cqw; }
.tm-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cream); outline-offset: 3px; }
.tm-hours { left: 23.6%; top: 51.4%; }
.tm-hours-n { font-weight: 800; font-size: 4.2cqw; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tm-hours-n small { font-size: 0.4em; margin-left: 0.2cqw; color: var(--cream-2); }
.tm-hours-l { margin-top: 0.4cqw; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.8cqw; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream-2); }
.tm-ring { left: 35.2%; top: 50.8%; width: 5.4%; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.tm-ring svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.tm-secs { left: 42.6%; top: 51.4%; width: 29.2%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1.1cqw; }
.tm-sec { position: relative; padding: 0.8cqw 0.9cqw 0.85cqw; border: 1px solid rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.6); background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.06); }
.tm-sec::before { content: attr(data-tag); position: absolute; top: -0.7cqw; left: 0.8cqw; padding: 0.08cqw 0.45cqw; background: var(--sec); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.68cqw; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-weight: 700; }
.tm-sec[data-tag="CREATIVES"] { --sec: var(--coral); } .tm-sec[data-tag="PRODUCTION"] { --sec: var(--mustard); } .tm-sec[data-tag="GENERAL"] { --sec: var(--lilac); }
.tm-sec-n { font-weight: 800; font-size: 2.2cqw; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tm-sec-n small { font-size: 0.45em; color: var(--cream-2); }
.tm-sec-s { margin-top: 0.35cqw; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72cqw; color: var(--cream-2); }
.tm-sec-bar { margin-top: 0.5cqw; height: 0.3cqw; background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.2); }
.tm-sec-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--sec); }
.tm-people { left: 23.6%; top: 62.4%; width: 48.2%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1cqw; }
.tm-person { position: relative; padding: 0.7cqw 0.9cqw 0.75cqw; border-radius: 0.5cqw; background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.94); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0.5cqw 1cqw -0.5cqw rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1); }
.tm-person:hover { transform: translateY(-0.4cqw) rotate(-1deg); }
.tm-person-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5cqw; }
.tm-person-n { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05cqw; }
.tm-person-h { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.8cqw; color: #7a6248; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.tm-person-bar { margin-top: 0.45cqw; display: flex; height: 0.38cqw; border-radius: 1cqw; overflow: hidden; background: #e6dbc6; }
.tm-person-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; }
.tm-spot { width: 0; height: 0; }
.tm-spot button { appearance: none; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1.5cqw; height: 1.5cqw; margin: -0.75cqw 0 0 -0.75cqw; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.35cqw rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.3); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .tm-spot button { animation: tm-ping 2.8s ease-out infinite; animation-delay: var(--pd, 0s); } @keyframes tm-ping { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.6); } 70%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.4cqw rgba(246, 238, 221, 0); } } }
.tm-spot button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 3px; }
.tm-tip { position: absolute; left: 1.3cqw; top: -0.9cqw; z-index: 4; min-width: 12cqw; padding: 0.7cqw 0.9cqw; border-radius: 0.6cqw; background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.97); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0.8cqw 1.8cqw -0.6cqw rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.4cqw); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s, transform 0.25s; }
.tm-spot.left .tm-tip { left: auto; right: 1.3cqw; }
.tm-spot:hover .tm-tip, .tm-spot:focus-within .tm-tip { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.tm-tip b { display: block; font-size: 1cqw; font-weight: 800; }
.tm-tip span { display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72cqw; color: #6f5a43; line-height: 1.5; }
.tm-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 18px; padding: 12px 18px 14px; background: #2e1f12; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.72); }
.tm-strip b { color: var(--cream); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tm-more { padding: 0 18px 16px; background: #2e1f12; }
.tm-more summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.72); padding: 4px 0; }
.tm-more summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.tm-more summary::before { content: "+ "; color: var(--coral); }
.tm-tablewrap { margin-top: 8px; overflow-x: auto; background: #fbf5ea; color: var(--ink); border-radius: 10px; }
.tm-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; min-width: 600px; }
.tm-table th { text-align: left; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a7058; font-weight: 400; padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ecdfca; }
.tm-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #f2e7d7; }
.tm-table .num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
@container (max-width: 640px) { .tm-secs, .tm-people, .tm-spot, .tm-days, .tm-kicker, .tm-ring { display: none; } .tm-title { font-size: 8cqw; } .tm-dates, .tm-switch { font-size: 1.9cqw; } .tm-toggle { width: 8cqw; height: 4cqw; } .tm-toggle::after { width: 3.3cqw; height: 3.3cqw; top: 0.35cqw; left: 0.35cqw; --knob: 4cqw; } .tm-hours { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; top: 52%; } .tm-hours-n { font-size: 7cqw; } .tm-hours-l { font-size: 1.7cqw; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .tm.is-in .tm-photo { animation: tm-focus 1.6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both; }
  .tm.is-in .tm-pop { animation: tm-pop 0.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) both; animation-delay: var(--d, 0.6s); }
  .tm.is-in .tm-light { animation: tm-drift 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes tm-focus { from { filter: blur(14px) brightness(0.65) saturate(0.7); transform: scale(1.07); } }
  @keyframes tm-pop { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 1.1cqw; scale: 0.95; } }
  @keyframes tm-drift { to { transform: translateX(5%); } }
}
.bp {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(16px, 2.6vw, 28px);
  display: grid;
  gap: 22px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 100% 64px,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 64px 100%,
    linear-gradient(rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 100% 16px,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 16px 100%,
    radial-gradient(120% 80% at 20% 0%, #135a50, #0c3f39 70%);
  color: var(--cream);
}
.bp-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px 24px; }
.bp-eyebrow { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--coral); }
.bp-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.bp-stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
.bp-stat { min-width: 92px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px dashed rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; }
.bp-stat b { display: block; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.bp-stat span { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream-2); }
.bp-block { display: grid; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.bp-label { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream); }
.bp-label em { font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: none; color: var(--cream-2); }
.bp-timeline { overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.bp-timeline svg { display: block; height: 150px; }
.bp-node { cursor: pointer; }
.bp-node:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.bp-node:focus-visible rect.hit { stroke: var(--cream); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.bp-people { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.bp-chip { appearance: none; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: var(--cream); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 12px 5px 5px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.35); background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.04); transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; }
.bp-chip:hover { background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.1); }
.bp-chip.on { background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--cream); }
.bp-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 2px; }
.bp-chip i { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-style: normal; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); }
.bp-chip small { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.75; }
.bp-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .bp-board { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.bp-col { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.28); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(6, 30, 27, 0.25); }
.bp-col-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.28); }
.bp-col-head b { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.bp-col-head b::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--col); vertical-align: 0; }
.bp-col-head span { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--cream-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.bp-list { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 10px; max-height: 420px; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.bp-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px 10px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.06); border: 1px solid transparent; transition: opacity 0.25s, background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; }
.bp-card:hover { background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.12); border-color: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.3); }
.bp-card.sub { margin-left: 14px; }
.bp-card.dim { opacity: 0.22; }
.bp-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; grid-row: span 2; }
.bp-card-t { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.3; overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; }
.bp-card-h { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; grid-row: span 2; text-align: right; }
.bp-card-m { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--cream-2); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.bp-empty { padding: 14px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--cream-2); }
.bp-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--cream-2); }
.bp-legend li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.bp-legend i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }

.tm-peoplerow { left: 23.6%; top: 64%; width: 48.2%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1cqw; align-items: stretch; }
.tm-peoplerow .tm-people { position: static; left: auto; top: auto; width: auto; }
.tm-team { display: flex; }
.tm-team button { appearance: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7cqw; padding: 0.6cqw 1cqw 0.6cqw 0.7cqw; border-radius: 0.5cqw; border: 1px dashed rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.75); background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.08); color: var(--cream); text-align: left; font: inherit; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
.tm-team button:hover { background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.18); transform: translateY(-0.2cqw); }
.tm-team button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 2px; }
.tm-team button i { flex: none; width: 2cqw; height: 2cqw; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.8cqw; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); }
.tm-team button b { display: block; font-size: 1cqw; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap; }
.tm-team button small { display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72cqw; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--cream-2); white-space: nowrap; }
.tm-team button.is-person { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--coral); background: rgba(240, 122, 95, 0.18); }
.tm-team button.is-person i { background: var(--coral); color: var(--cream); }
@container (max-width: 640px) { .tm-peoplerow { display: none; } }
.tm-sun { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: soft-light; transition: background 1.2s ease, opacity 1.2s ease; }
.tm-dust { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: screen; }
.tm-lamp { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s ease; mix-blend-mode: soft-light; background: radial-gradient(circle 16cqw at var(--lx, 50%) var(--ly, 50%), rgba(255, 226, 170, 0.9), rgba(255, 226, 170, 0) 70%); }
.tm-scene:hover .tm-lamp { opacity: 1; }
.tm-dim { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.35s ease; background: radial-gradient(circle at var(--sx, 50%) var(--sy, 50%), rgba(8, 18, 16, 0) 6cqw, rgba(8, 18, 16, 0.62) 15cqw); }
.tm-scene.spot-on .tm-dim { opacity: 1; }
.tm-scene.spot-on .tm-o:not(.tm-spot) { opacity: 0.35; transition: opacity 0.35s ease; }
.tm-o { transition: opacity 0.35s ease; }
.tm-scene.zoomed .tm-photo { transform: scale(var(--zs, 2)) !important; transform-origin: var(--zx, 50%) var(--zy, 50%); transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.2,1), transform-origin 0s; }
.tm-scene.zoomed .tm-o:not(.tm-spot), .tm-scene.zoomed .tm-spot:not(.zoom-active), .tm-scene.zoomed .tm-dim, .tm-scene.zoomed .tm-lamp { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.tm-scene.zoomed .tm-spot.zoom-active { left: 50% !important; top: 46% !important; transition: left 0.6s ease, top 0.6s ease; }
.tm-scene.zoomed .tm-spot.zoom-active .tm-tip { opacity: 1; transform: none; left: 50%; top: 2cqw; translate: -50% 0; min-width: 22cqw; padding: 1.2cqw 1.4cqw; }
.tm-scene.zoomed .tm-spot.zoom-active .tm-tip b { font-size: 1.8cqw; }
.tm-scene.zoomed .tm-spot.zoom-active .tm-tip span { font-size: 1cqw; }
.tm-zoomout { position: absolute; right: 2%; top: 3%; z-index: 6; appearance: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.6cqw 1.1cqw; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: rgba(246, 238, 221, 0.95); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.85cqw; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 0.4cqw 1cqw -0.3cqw rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
.tm-scene:not(.zoomed) .tm-zoomout { display: none; }
.tm-zoomout:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 2px; }
@container (max-width: 640px) { .tm-lamp, .tm-dim, .tm-dust { display: none; } }
.tm-person { appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font: inherit; width: 100%; }
.tm-person.on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25cqw var(--coral), 0 0.5cqw 1cqw -0.5cqw rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); }
.tm-person.off { opacity: 0.55; }
.tm-person:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 2px; }

<script>
dash.loader('tasks', {
  description: 'Reads every page of the Jira search and makes one row per work item per PS-CREATIVES sprint it belongs to, with hours converted from seconds.',
  fn: async ({ answer, call, args }) => {
    const parse = (a) => (typeof a === 'string' ? JSON.parse(a) : a);
    let a = parse(answer);
    const nodes = [];
    let truncated = false;
    for (let page = 0; page < 20; page++) {
      if (a && a.error) throw new Error(a.error.message || String(a.error));
      const box = a && a.issues;
      nodes.push(...(Array.isArray(box) ? box : (box && Array.isArray(box.nodes) ? box.nodes : [])));
      const info = box && box.pageInfo;
      if (!info || !info.hasNextPage || !info.endCursor) break;
      if (page === 19) { truncated = true; break; }
      a = parse(await call('searchJiraIssuesUsingJql', Object.assign({}, args, { nextPageToken: info.endCursor })));
    }
    const rows = [];
    for (const n of nodes) {
      const f = n.fields || {};
      const cf = f.customFields || {};
      const sprints = (cf.Sprint && cf.Sprint.value) || f.customfield_10020 || [];
      const sec = (cf.Section && cf.Section.value && cf.Section.value.value) || (f.customfield_10472 && f.customfield_10472.value) || 'No section';
      const multi = (name, id) => { const v = (cf[name] && cf[name].value) || f[id] || []; return (Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]).map((o) => (o && o.value) || '').filter(Boolean).join(' / '); };
      const game = multi('Game', 'customfield_10471'), persona = multi('Persona', 'customfield_10468');
      for (const s of sprints) {
        if (!s || s.boardId !== 203 || s.state === 'future') continue;
        rows.push({
          key: n.key,
          sprint_id: s.id,
          sprint: s.name,
          sprint_state: s.state,
          sprint_start: s.startDate || '',
          sprint_end: s.endDate || '',
          summary: String(f.summary || '').trim(),
          person: f.assignee && f.assignee.displayName ? f.assignee.displayName : 'Unassigned',
          status: f.status && f.status.name ? f.status.name : '',
          section: sec,
          game,
          persona,
          estimated_h: Math.round(((f.timeoriginalestimate || 0) / 3600) * 100) / 100,
          logged_h: Math.round(((f.timespent || 0) / 3600) * 100) / 100,
          subtask: !!(f.issuetype && f.issuetype.subtask)
        });
      }
    }
    return { columns: ['key', 'sprint_id', 'sprint', 'sprint_state', 'sprint_start', 'sprint_end', 'summary', 'person', 'status', 'section', 'game', 'persona', 'estimated_h', 'logged_h', 'subtask'], rows, truncated };
  }
});

dash.calc('sprints', {
  title: 'Sprints',
  description: 'Every started PS-CREATIVES sprint found in the work items, newest first.',
  inputs: ['tasks'],
  fn: (tasks) => {
    const seen = {};
    for (const r of tasks) if (!seen[r.sprint_id]) seen[r.sprint_id] = { sprint_id: r.sprint_id, sprint: r.sprint, state: r.sprint_state, start: r.sprint_start, end: r.sprint_end };
    return Object.values(seen).sort((a, b) => String(b.start).localeCompare(String(a.start)));
  }
});

dash.calc('current', {
  title: 'Sprint shown',
  description: 'The sprint picked in the dropdown, or the active sprint if none is picked, with its dates, working days and capacity (60h per person, 54h in Sprint 1).',
  inputs: ['sprints', 'tasks'],
  fn: (sprints, tasks) => {
    if (!sprints || !sprints.length) return [];
    const picked = Number(dash.params().sprint) || 0;
    const s = sprints.find((x) => x.sprint_id === picked) || sprints.find((x) => x.state === 'active') || sprints[0];
    const capEach = { 'PS-CREAT Sprint 1': 54 }[s.sprint] || 60;
    const people = 4; /* team size: Usama, Daniyal, Hamza, Arslan */
    const day = (d) => { const t = new Date(d); return Date.UTC(t.getUTCFullYear(), t.getUTCMonth(), t.getUTCDate()); };
    const workdays = (a, b) => { let n = 0; for (let t = a; t <= b; t += 86400000) { const w = new Date(t).getUTCDay(); if (w !== 0 && w !== 6) n++; } return n; };
    const start = s.start ? day(s.start) : null;
    const end = s.end ? day(s.end) : null;
    const total = start && end ? workdays(start, end) : 0;
    const today = day(Date.now());
    const elapsed = start && end ? Math.max(0, Math.min(total, workdays(start, Math.min(today, end)))) : 0;
    const fmt = (t) => new Date(t).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' });
    return [{
      sprint_id: s.sprint_id,
      sprint: s.sprint,
      short: String(s.sprint).replace('PS-CREAT ', ''),
      state: s.state,
      state_label: s.state === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Completed',
      dates: start && end ? `${fmt(start)} – ${fmt(end)}` : '',
      days_total: total,
      days_elapsed: elapsed,
      progress_label: s.state === 'active' ? `Day ${elapsed} of ${total} working days` : `Completed · ${total} working days`,
      people,
      cap_each: capEach,
      capacity: (dash.params().person ? 1 : people) * capEach,
      viewing: [dash.params().person ? String(dash.params().person).split(' ')[0] : 'whole team', dash.params().section ? String(dash.params().section).replace(' Sprint', '').replace(' Tasks', '').toLowerCase() : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
    }];
  }
});

dash.calc('totals', {
  title: 'Sprint totals',
  description: 'Hours logged and estimated, items done, in review, in progress and rolled over, for the sprint shown, narrowed to the person or section picked.',
  inputs: ['tasks', 'current'],
  fn: (tasks, current) => {
    if (!current || !current[0]) return [];
    const who = dash.params().person || ''; const sec_ = dash.params().section || ''; const rs = tasks.filter((r) => r.sprint_id === current[0].sprint_id && (!who || r.person === who) && (!sec_ || r.section === sec_));
    const sum = (list, k) => Math.round(list.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r[k]) || 0), 0) * 10) / 10;
    const rolled = rs.filter((r) => r.status === 'Rollover');
    const logged = sum(rs, 'logged_h');
    return [{
      logged,
      estimated: sum(rs, 'estimated_h'),
      items: rs.length,
      done: rs.filter((r) => r.status === 'Done').length,
      in_review: rs.filter((r) => r.status === 'In Review').length,
      in_progress: rs.filter((r) => r.status === 'In Progress' || r.status === 'Reopened').length,
      rolled: rolled.length,
      rolled_h: sum(rolled, 'logged_h'),
      cap_pct: current[0].capacity ? Math.round((logged / current[0].capacity) * 100) : 0
    }];
  }
});

dash.calc('by_section', {
  title: 'Hours by section',
  description: 'For the sprint shown: hours logged and estimated, item count, items done and the status mix in each section.',
  inputs: ['tasks', 'current'],
  fn: (tasks, current) => {
    if (!current || !current[0]) return [];
    const who = dash.params().person || ''; const all = tasks.filter((r) => r.sprint_id === current[0].sprint_id && (!who || r.person === who));
    return ['Creatives Sprint', 'Production', 'General Tasks'].map((section) => {
      const rs = all.filter((r) => r.section === section);
      const sum = (k) => Math.round(rs.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r[k]) || 0), 0) * 10) / 10;
      const n = (...st) => rs.filter((r) => st.includes(r.status)).length;
      return { section, logged: sum('logged_h'), estimated: sum('estimated_h'), items: rs.length, done: n('Done'), todo: n('To Do'), rollover: n('Rollover'), in_progress: n('In Progress', 'Reopened'), in_review: n('In Review'), blocked: n('Blocked', 'Paused') };
    });
  }
});

dash.calc('by_person', {
  title: 'Hours by person',
  description: 'For the sprint shown: hours logged per person, split by section, against their capacity. Narrowed to one section when one is picked.',
  inputs: ['tasks', 'current'],
  fn: (tasks, current) => {
    if (!current || !current[0]) return [];
    const cap = current[0].cap_each;
    const people = {};

      const p = people[r.person] = people[r.person] || { person: r.person, logged: 0, creatives: 0, production: 0, general: 0, items: 0 };

    mk('rect', { class: 'hit', x: x - slot / 2 + 8, y: 6, width: slot - 16, height: H - 12, rx: 6, fill: on ? 'rgba(246,238,221,0.08)' : 'transparent', stroke: on ? 'rgba(246,238,221,0.45)' : 'transparent', 'stroke-dasharray': '3 3' }, g);
    const bh = Math.max(3, base - y);
    mk('rect', { x: x - 16, y: base - bh, width: 32, height: bh, fill: on ? '#f07a5f' : 'rgba(246,238,221,0.22)', stroke: on ? '#f6eedd' : 'rgba(246,238,221,0.5)', 'stroke-width': 1 }, g);
    const done = r.items ? r.done / r.items : 0;
    mk('rect', { x: x - 16, y: base - bh * done, width: 4, height: bh * done, fill: '#8fd3b6' }, g);
    const v = mk('text', { x, y: base - bh - 8, 'text-anchor': 'middle', fill: '#f6eedd' }, g); v.style.font = '800 15px var(--sans)'; v.textContent = `${TM.fmt(r.logged)}h`;
    const t1 = mk('text', { x, y: base + 22, 'text-anchor': 'middle', fill: on ? '#f6eedd' : 'rgba(246,238,221,0.75)' }, g); t1.style.font = `${on ? 700 : 500} 12px var(--mono)`; t1.textContent = String(r.sprint).replace('PS-CREAT ', '');
    const t2 = mk('text', { x, y: base + 38, 'text-anchor': 'middle', fill: 'rgba(246,238,221,0.6)' }, g); t2.style.font = '10.5px var(--mono)'; t2.textContent = `${r.done}/${r.items} done`;
    const go = () => dash.setParams({ sprint: r.sprint_id });
    g.addEventListener('click', go);
    g.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); go(); } });
  });
  box.appendChild(svg);
  const curIdx = h.data.findIndex((r) => r.sprint_id === cur);
  if (curIdx >= 0) box.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, pts[curIdx][0] - (box.clientWidth || 600) / 2);
});

/* People chips: click to highlight one person's work on the board */
dash.draw('pfilter', (box) => {
  const d = dash.data('by_person');
  box.replaceChildren();
  if (d.status !== 'ok' || !Array.isArray(d.data)) return;
  const sel = dash.params().person || ''; const all = document.createElement('button'); all.type = 'button'; all.className = 'bp-chip' + (sel ? '' : ' on'); all.textContent = 'Everyone';
  all.style.paddingLeft = '12px';
  all.setAttribute('aria-pressed', sel ? 'false' : 'true');
  all.addEventListener('click', () => TM.pick(''));
  box.appendChild(all);
  d.data.forEach((r, i) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'bp-chip' + (sel === r.person ? ' on' : '');
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', sel === r.person ? 'true' : 'false');
    const av = document.createElement('i'); av.style.background = TM.PCOL[i % TM.PCOL.length]; av.textContent = r.person.split(' ').map((w) => w[0]).join('').slice(0, 2);
    const nm = document.createElement('span'); nm.textContent = r.person.split(' ')[0];
    const hr = document.createElement('small'); hr.textContent = `${TM.fmt(r.logged)}h`;
    b.append(av, nm, hr);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => TM.pick(sel === r.person ? '' : r.person));
    box.appendChild(b);
  });
});

/* The board: one column per section, a small card per work item */
dash.draw('board', (box) => {
  const d = dash.data('tasks'), c = dash.data('current'), P = dash.data('by_person');
  box.replaceChildren();
  if (d.status !== 'ok' || !Array.isArray(d.data) || c.status !== 'ok' || !c.data || !c.data[0]) { const p = document.createElement('div'); p.className = 'bp-empty'; p.textContent = d.status === 'error' ? 'Failed to load' : 'Loading work…'; box.appendChild(p); return; }
  const rows = d.data.filter((r) => r.sprint_id === c.data[0].sprint_id);
  const order = P.status === 'ok' && Array.isArray(P.data) ? P.data.map((r) => r.person) : [];
  const pcol = (p) => TM.PCOL[(order.indexOf(p) >= 0 ? order.indexOf(p) : 5) % TM.PCOL.length];
  [['Creatives Sprint', 'Creatives', '#f07a5f'], ['Production', 'Production', '#e8b44a'], ['General Tasks', 'General', '#b9a6e0']].forEach(([sec, label, col]) => {
    const items = rows.filter((r) => r.section === sec);
    const secSel = dash.params().section || '';
    const colEl = document.createElement('div'); colEl.className = 'bp-col' + (secSel === sec ? ' on' : (secSel ? ' off' : '')); colEl.style.setProperty('--col', col);
    const head = document.createElement('div'); head.className = 'bp-col-head';
    const hb = document.createElement('b'); hb.textContent = label;
    const hs = document.createElement('span');
    const hrs = Math.round(items.reduce((a, r) => a + (Number(r.logged_h) || 0), 0) * 10) / 10;
    hs.textContent = `${items.filter((r) => r.status === 'Done').length}/${items.length} done · ${hrs}h`;
    head.append(hb, hs);
    head.title = 'Click to show only ' + label;
    head.addEventListener('click', () => TM.pickSec(secSel === sec ? '' : sec));
    const list = document.createElement('div'); list.className = 'bp-list';
    if (!items.length) { const e = document.createElement('div'); e.className = 'bp-empty'; e.textContent = 'Nothing here yet.'; list.appendChild(e); }
    items.forEach((r) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      const sel = dash.params().person || ''; card.className = 'bp-card' + (r.subtask ? ' sub' : '') + (sel && sel !== r.person ? ' dim' : '');
      card.title = `${r.key} · ${r.status}`;
      const dot = document.createElement('span'); dot.className = 'bp-dot'; dot.style.background = TM.STATUS[r.status] || 'rgba(246,238,221,0.4)';
      const t = document.createElement('div'); t.className = 'bp-card-t'; t.textContent = r.summary;
      const h = document.createElement('div'); h.className = 'bp-card-h'; h.textContent = `${TM.fmt(r.logged_h)}h`;
      const m = document.createElement('div'); m.className = 'bp-card-m';
      const who = document.createElement('span'); who.textContent = '● '; who.style.color = pcol(r.person);
      m.append(who, document.createTextNode(`${r.person.split(' ')[0]} · ${r.status.toLowerCase()}`));
      card.append(dot, t, h, m);
      if (r.game || r.persona) { const tg = document.createElement('div'); tg.className = 'bp-tags'; for (const [cls, val] of [['game', r.game], ['persona', r.persona]]) { if (!val) continue; for (const one of String(val).split(' / ')) { const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className = 'bp-tag ' + cls; s.textContent = one; tg.appendChild(s); } } card.appendChild(tg); }
      list.appendChild(card);
    });
    colEl.append(head, list);
    box.appendChild(colEl);
  });
});
</script>
